purpose: Re-measure current Assistants-to-Responses migration demand without unsolicited outreach or counting repository issues as revenue.

inspected.reason: Bug report offers maintainer help and contains no paid-purchase intent.
Repository-owned follow-up list after an existing migration.
Notebook maintenance acceptance criteria, not a commercial purchase request.
Open-source acceptance criteria with no purchase intent.

decision: Do not treat broad issue counts as qualified demand and do not post promotional replies. Keep the verified live product measurable; the highest-conversion prepared change remains the tested Sites version 28 CTA, which requires the recorded final-publication decision.
success_condition: A verified sale, checkout signal, or explicit opt-in commercial request.
withdrawal_condition: If the dated effect window passes without a verified sale or qualified checkout signal, change customer, channel, or offer layer rather than repeating issue-search or SEO polish.
next_resume_point: After an owner publication decision or new authorized analytics source, deploy/read back the prepared CTA or measure sales and checkout evidence; otherwise explore a different zero-operation channel.
